div.div: Submit inserts the accepted-jobs row first, then publishes the pointer message, and the reconciler republishes rows that have no publish receipt. One unique constraint on tenant and submission key dedups at submit. Temporal owns job lifecycle, Postgres holds the row of record and the event history is append only. The envelope carries identity and refs, never accumulated state.
